instruction: List cron jobs for a repository
Create a cron job in Drone
output: drone cron create owner/repo nightly '@daily' --branch main
drone cron update owner/repo nightly --branch develop

instruction: Update a user's role in Drone
List all registered runners in Drone

output: drone orgsecret add myorg SECRET_KEY value

instruction: Use Drone with a specific server
Set Drone CLI token via environment
Create a .drone.yml pipeline with clone step disabled
output: echo 'kind: pipeline type: docker name: default clone: disable steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build' > .drone.yml
echo 'kind: pipeline steps: - name: test image: golang commands: - go test services: - name: db image: postgres:16 environment: POSTGRES_DB: test' > .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: build image: node:20 environment: NODE_ENV: production commands: - npm build' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: alpine commands: - echo deploy when: branch: - main event: - push' >> .drone.yml
